definitions.explanation: A whole made up of many similar parts gathered together, whether physical things (a cluster of cells, holes or bubbles) or abstract ones (a society seen as a collection of individuals).

examples.japanese: ⟦{細胞|さいぼう}→細胞：05030_saibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集合体|しゅうごうたい}。
⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集合体|しゅうごうたい}だ。
examples.english: Society is a collection of individuals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集合体|しゅうごうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{鳥肌|とりはだ}→鳥肌：08544_torihada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}なくない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: Quite a few people get goosebumps when they see clusters of small holes.

notes:
USAGE:
Often in the pattern X⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集合体|しゅうごうたい} (an aggregate of X). Online, {集合体|しゅうごうたい} on its own often means clusters of holes or dots like a lotus seed head, and {集合体|しゅうごうたい}⟦{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}→恐怖症：27678_kyoufushou⟧ is trypophobia, the fear of such patterns.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{集|あつ}まり→集まり：01689_atsumari⟧: gathering (of people); collection (everyday word)
- ⟦{集団|しゅうだん}→集団：03211_shuudan⟧: group of people or animals acting together
- ⟦{塊|かたまり}→塊：03905_katamari⟧: lump, mass (a solid clump)
